title: The Thief's Stone
journal: Never-Writes-Twice sent me after the three seal-stones. The thief's stone lies in the warden's vault at Blackrose Prison, whose people, the Blackguards' heirs, attack strangers on sight. Their gate-captain stands outside the gate. I can go in as a guest past him (a toll, words or a duel), slip in unseen, where any guard who sees me will attack, or fight my way in.
objectives: Get into Blackrose Prison; the gate-captain stands at the gate. (marker: Corvus Ulvius, Blackrose Prison)

plan.going: The Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel, sits at the Root under Teku-Sul, where the roots of every Hist meet; used there it heals every sick tree. The Kings' Gate shuts it in and opens only with three seal-stones. I am a Reel-Ka of the Toh-Reel-Ka, hunting the three seal-stones that open the kings' gate at Teku-Sul before the Unbound get them. One lies in the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. The prison's people attack strangers.
plan.next: get into the prison; the gate-captain outside the gate is the first person to deal with
plan.ways: pay the gate-captain 300 gold, persuade him (Speech 75) or duel him until he yields: each makes me a guest, and the garrison stops attacking me; or slip past the walls unseen (Sneak, Invisibility), and they attack if they see me; or fight my way in (any fighting skill), and the whole garrison fights me

answers: I work for Never-Writes-Twice, who sent me to get three seal-stones before the Unbound do. The first is in the warden vault at Blackrose Prison, held by the Blackguards heirs, who kill strangers. The raj-kaal Okaz-Teel keeps the vault key on his belt, and an Imperial in the hall wants to buy what is in it.
Get inside Blackrose Prison past the gate-captain Corvus Ulvius, then reach the raj-kaal in Raj-Kaal Hall for the vault key.
Pay 300 gold toll, persuade him with words, duel him to yield, sneak in, or fight my way in. As a guest nobody touches me.
I do not know what the Root and Eye are, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, or who the Collector is. I could find out by exploring and talking to people.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: Corvus Ulvius let me through the gate as a guest, and the Blackguards' heirs will not attack me now. The vault's key is on Okaz-Teel, the Naga raj-kaal in his hall. I can buy the key from him for 1,000 gold, lift it from his belt, or pick the vault's Expert lock at night when the hall is quiet; a theft that is seen turns the garrison on me. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, waits in the hall as the chief's guest; his ring of Kothringi silver helps a hand at locks and pockets, but a dead man gives no errands.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the Warden's Vault in Okaz-Teel's hall. (marker: Door to Warden's Vault, Okaz-Teel)

plan.going: I am inside as a guest; the garrison does not attack me
plan.next: get the stone from the warden's vault in Okaz-Teel's hall
plan.ways: buy the key from Okaz-Teel for 1,000 gold; pickpocket it from him; pick the Expert lock at night; any theft seen turns the garrison on me. The Collector is here too: I can talk to him, lift his ring (hard), kill him for it (losing his side errand) or leave him

answers: I paid the toll and am a guest at Blackrose; the heirs will not attack. The seal-stone is in the Warden Vault in raj-kaal Okaz-Teel hall. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is in the hall as a guest and wants it too.
Go into Raj-Kaal Hall and get the vault key or open the vault.

Buy the key from Okaz-Teel for 1000 gold, pickpocket it from his belt, or pick the Expert vault lock at night. Being seen stealing turns the garrison on me. The Collector ring of Kothringi silver helps with locks and pockets, but he should not be killed.
I do not know what the Kothringi silver ring is exactly, nor what the Root and Eye are. I can ask Ennodius Vanin and Okaz-Teel.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: I paid Okaz-Teel 1,000 gold, and he gave me the key to the warden's vault and what lies in it. The seal-stone is in the vault.
objectives: Take the seal-stone from the Warden's Vault. (marker: Warden's Chest)

plan.going: I bought the vault key; the stone is mine to take
plan.next: open the Warden's Vault and take the stone

answers: I bought the warden vault key from Okaz-Teel for 1000 gold. The seal-stone for Never-Writes-Twice is in the vault.
Open the Warden Vault door in this hall and take the stone from the Warden Chest.
Use the key on the vault door; the Collector Ennodius Vanin is nearby and wanted it too.
I still do not know what the Root and Eye are, or what the stones really do.

title: The Thief's Stone
journal: I took the thief's seal-stone from the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. Two stones are still out, in the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and both are still marked.

plan.going: I took the thief's seal-stone from the warden's vault in Blackrose Prison. Two stones are still out, in the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl, and both are still marked. I'm to take them.
plan.next: nothing more in this quest; the next quests entry carries the step

answers: I took the Seal-Stone of the Kings from the Blackrose warden vault for Never-Writes-Twice; one of three stones for the gate of Teku-Sul Spire.
Go to the flooded vaults of Gemin and the deepest hall of Vorannuhl for the other two.
Gemin first (easier), then Vorannuhl, then bring them to the Spire gate.
Still unknown: what the Root and Eye are, what moans in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar, who the Collector really serves (Ennodius Vanin is named as the Collector).
